purpose: Measure whether frozen visual representations learned by the Stage-1 generative VLM improve a DINOv3 human grounder.
entry_conditions: G3 full Stage-1 five-task generated evaluation passed
a compact Stage-1 checkpoint with frozen Qwen Vision and merger is reproducibly loadable
the DINOv3 main checkpoint is fixed before reading Stage-2 outputs
the DINO task decoder and no-small evaluator are identical across all Stage-2 arms

locked_data_flow.rgb: The same geometrically transformed RGB image is sent directly to DINOv3.
locked_data_flow.qwen: The frozen Stage-1 Qwen Vision receives the same image canvas with Qwen-specific normalization.
locked_data_flow.feature: Pre-merger spatial Qwen features are projected to the DINO decoder width and fused only on the DINO side.
prohibited: feeding Qwen features as extra RGB channels
using Stage-1 generated labels as pseudo ground truth
changing DINO decoders between comparison arms

trainable: DINOv3 selected blocks or adapters under one frozen recipe
Qwen-to-DINO feature projection and fusion bridge
one shared set of DINO task decoders for box, segment, pose, age, and gender

matched_arms.input: RGB to DINOv3 plus frozen native-Qwen visual features
RGB to DINOv3 plus frozen Stage-1 human-adapted visual features

controls: zeroed Qwen features with the bridge retained

requirements: Qwen and DINO geometry maps to the same pixel canvas
feature tensor shapes are recorded for every selected layer
base and adapted Qwen use the same feature space and layer
zero-initialized bridge reproduces DINO-only logits within tolerance
image shuffle changes fused outputs but not DINO-only outputs

S2_G1_DINO_BASELINE.requirement: A separately trained DINO-only checkpoint completes generated no-small five-task validation.

requirements: all three arms train from their stated independent initializations
adapted-Qwen visual transfer exceeds base-Qwen visual transfer on the frozen primary aggregate
adapted-Qwen visual transfer improves at least two of Box, Segment, and Pose
image-shuffle control removes the transfer gain
no spatial task degrades by more than the pre-registered tolerance

current_assets.paper_intended_large_checkpoint: not present and not yet frozen

historical_run.qwen_source: historical v3_repr adapter, not the active generative Stage-1

gaps: frozen choice of the main DINOv3 checkpoint
current Qwen3.5 generative checkpoint loader and pre-merger feature API
next_steps_after_stage1: Run S2_G0 using existing DINOv3-S without downloading another model.
Freeze the paper DINOv3 scale only after the interface gate passes and storage is audited.
Train S2_A, S2_B, and S2_C as separate matched checkpoints.
Evaluate all arms with the same five-task no-small scorer.
Promote C2 only if S2_G2 and image-shuffle specificity pass.
current_decision: Do not launch or tune Stage-2 while Stage-1 remains below G3.
